seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms, takes courier jobs, and investigates the Ugathul threat, Embercall's radar dishes, and the Roundhat Gang, becoming consultants for the Magical Crimes Convox — culminating in a catastrophic near-total party kill at the Crowded Flea.

seasons.title: Death, Rebirth, and Revenge
seasons.arc_summary: Three party members die and navigate the Black and White void, meeting the entity Aut and returning to life at a cost. The reformed party hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, uncovering six Thessian gods attempting to breach the Firmament via radar dishes.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Cosmic revelations about the Narrative — five sibling entities including Aut — reshape the party's understanding of their world. They attend the Pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, survive a gladiatorial trial, solve a keystone scavenger hunt, and trade a stolen painting to secure Keystone 14.

seasons.title: The Firmament Fracture
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns as only half a man, and during an extended downtime the party discovers a hairline crack in reality beneath Teller's Run — a parallel world where a two-mile-tall god stands imprisoned. After hacking a terminal to uncover a vast conspiracy, they bomb the research facility and flee as ash rains over the city.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party boards the colossal Strider for a voidward pilgrimage, birthing their own heart 'Eerie,' navigating deadly faction politics and a weekly tithe of magical energy, and descending into the ancient Undercroft to befriend a dormant Machine God.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Quorum Descent
seasons.arc_summary: Four high-ranking Scale operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a slip-shielded structure, where they breach the fiend-built Quorum, battle Sigzilheight's forces, and ultimately discover and liberate Voice of Many — a trapped divine heart and grandchild of the Judge — before escaping back to Scale headquarters.

seasons.title: Into the Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: Three Convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a vanished pilgrim, follow a Feyrock necklace into the mile-tall forest, and battle fey creatures of the Court of Masks — only to learn their suspect is dead and the curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The investigation shifts to Hallia, where the detectives trace fey-stone to a jeweler's conference and uncover a ritual murder apartment containing the Gloaming Codex — a cursed book that pulls the entire party into its pages to fight for survival against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunken in the slip, freeing a tortured ship AI, rotating the station back into real space, and uncovering that the Thessian Gremory (now 'Esoterica') accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement, the fire team raids the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian 'Tithe' before the God Eater Harrow can finish devouring it, navigating slip-space puzzles and spider temples to become the first and only fire team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
